title: Flora
content:
Type: FLOR
Papyrus: Flora Script, ObjectReference Script Flora are harvestable plants, crops, fungi, and other resources found in the game world. Editor Dialog: File:Flora_Editor.png - - - - Generally, you'll want to use "Harvest," but there may be exceptions. - Ingredient Production Ingredient: The item obtained by activating this Flora. This occurs when harvesting from this Flora. Spring: Summer: Fall: Winter: - - - . - Notes: - The Creation Kit isn't very strict about what Ingredients can be harvested from Flora. Any form type that can even potentially serve as an item can be selected. For example, all Lights will be shown in the drop-down menu, even when most of them aren't set to be usable as items.
